method.urban: Closest sampled source reference, 150 m sampling; geographic city clip. Proposal only, not travel time, road accessibility or approved coverage. Exact source streets/localities remain proposed exceptions.
method.uncertainty: Geographic city area >500 m from a table reference; diagnostic only, never a delivery radius.
method.localities: Existing OSM place polygons where available; point markers otherwise. No arbitrary circles or outer delivery limit inferred.
method.unlocated: No invented coordinate for an ambiguous/unlocated landmark.
